translation.name: In yancuic mononotzalistli ica Totecohtzin Jesucristo

book.name: SAN MATEO
book.title: IN YANCUIC TLAHTOLI ICA JESUCRISTO QUEN OQUIHCUILUI IN TETIOTLATITLANIL MATEO

content: In itlatitlaniluan in Juan Tlacuatequiyani oyahque tetlahtlaniyahque in Jesús
Ihcuac in Jesús otlan technonotzahque tehhuan in mahtlactli huan ome tetlamachticahuan, oquixohuac de ompa huan ohuilohuac tlanonotzalo ipan in oc sequin altepemen de inon tlalten.
Ihcuac in Juan ocatca telpiloyan, oquicaquiltihque ica tlen omochiutinemiyaya in Jesús. Yehhua oquintitlan sequin itlamachticahuan mayacan teitacan in Jesús,
huan otetlahtlanihque: ―Tel, ¿Tehhuatzin in Cristo, aquin hualuilohuasquiyani, noso ticchiyasque in oc seya?
In Jesús omonanquilihque: ―Xiyacan huan xiquiluican in Juan in tlen nanquitzticaten huan nanquicacticaten.

Xicnonotzacan quen in ixpatzacten tlachiyahque, huan in xonecuilten nehnemihque, huan in aquin pahpalanticaten pahtihque ica inon incocolis, huan in nacastemen tlacaquihque, huan in mijcamen ihsahque, huan in prohues quinmatiltiyahque in itlahtoltzin in Dios.
Huan mapacto in aquin ahmo moxihxicohua ica nehhua.

Ihcuac omocuepque inon itlatitlaniluan in Juan, in Jesús opehualoc quinnonotzalo in tlacamen ica in Juan: ―Nele ahmo onanyahque nanquitahque ipan in acahualtlahtli se tlacatl aquin san motlahtolpatla.
Huan in tlahmo, tel, ¿tlen onanyahque nanquitahque? ¿Quen se tlacatl cuahcuali itlaquen? ¿Tlahmo nanquimatihque in aquin ijcon tlaquentihtoc ompa yesque ichan in hueyixtoque?
In tlahmo ijcon, tel, ¿tleca onanchicoquisque? Tel, ¿omechmatilti ica se tlayolchicauqui? Inon melahuac, huan inon Juan ocachi achto de nochin tlayolchicaucamen.
Inon Juan yehhuatl in aquin ica mihtohua in Dios ipan in Itlahcuiloltzin:

content.text: Nehhua nictitlani in notlanonotzcau matlicana ica tehhua,

content: Ic nele namechiluiya, hasta axan ahmo oncan oc se tlacatl ocachi hueyi iquisca quen in Juan Tlacuatequiyani. Masque ijcon ca, in aquin ocachi ahmo tlen iquisca huan temajco in Dios, yehhuatl ocachi quihuelitaque quen Juan.
’Ic opeu tlanonotza in Juan Tlacuatequiyani hasta axan, in miyacten quinequihque mocalactisque ipan inon tetlatequiutilistzin Dios hasta ixtomamiquihque.
Tleca nochin tlayolchicaucamen huan in Moisés noyojqui oquihcuilohque ica in tetlatequiutilistzin in Dios hasta ic ohuala in Juan Tlacuatequiyani.

Huan tla nanquineltocasque, ijcon nanquinehnehuilisque quen inon Juan, yehhuatl in tlayolchicauqui iquisca quen in tlayolchicauqui Elías. Huan ic inin yeh in Juan in aquin oquihtohque oquipix tlen hualas.
In aquin quinequihque quicaquisque, maquichihuacan cuenta.
’Axan namechiluiya ica tlen niquinixnamiquis in tlacamen de inin tonali. Ixnesihque quen in cocone san mahuiltiyahque huan quinnotzahque in oc sequin:
“Tamechtlatlapitziliyahque ica in flauta quen ipan in mosihuautilistli huan ahmo onanmihtohtihque. Huan otitlocoxtoyahque quen ica in mijqui huan namehhuan nanyolchicahuahque.”
Ijcon niquihtohua tleca in Juan omosautoya huan niyan ahmo otlayic, huan nanquihtohuahque quipiya in ahmo cuali yehyecatl.

Niman onihuala, nehhuatl aquin Nitetiachicau ica nochin tlacatl, nitlacua huan nitlayi, huan namehhuan nanquihtohuahque san nimotema huan nihuintihtinemi, huan niintenonotzcau in tlahtlacolyohque huan in renderos. Huan in tlamatilistli den Dios quinextiliyahque in aquin nele tlamatihque.
In tlacamen aquin ahmo tetlacamatihque
Oncan in Jesús opehualoc moixtohuetzohuahque sequin altepemen canin omochiu miyac tlachiuten, tleca inon tlacamen ahmo omoyolcueptoyahque. Oquiniluihque:

―¡Prohues namehhuan den altepetl Corazín! ¡Prohues namehhuan den altepetl Betsaida! Namoixpa yonicchiu miyac tlachiuten huan ahmo nanmoyolcuepahque. Tla yehhuan den altepemen Tiro huan Sidón quitanihque inon tlachiuten, ihcuac inon moyolcuepanihque ica pinaucayotl, huan quincuatlaxilinihque in tleconextli ica intlocol.
Huan namechiluiya quen ipan inon tonali den tlixcomacalistli mechtlapanoltisque ocachi quen in tlacamen den inon altepemen.

Huan namehhuan den altepetl Capernaum, ¿nanquinehnehuiliyahque nanyasque neluicac? Huan nele mechixtlasasque in mictlan. Tleca in tla yehhuan den altepetl Sodoma quitanihque in tlachiuten tlen onicchiu namoixpa, inon altepetl yesquiyani hasta axan.
Huan namechiluiya ipan in tonali den tlixcomacalistli namehhuan mechtlapanoltisque ocachi chicahuac quen in tlacamen den tlali Sodoma.
Xihualacan ica nehhua huan nanmosehuisque

Huan ic omonehnehuilihtehuac, in Jesús omihto: ―Nohueyitahtzin, huan Itecohtzin in neluicactli huan in tlalticpactli, nitemahuestiliya tleca motlatihtoc inin tlamatilistli ica in ixtlamatcamen, huan monextilihtoque ica in aquin ahmo machtihtoque.
Queme, Nohueyitahtzin, tleca ijconon tequin monectoc.

’Notahtzin nechmactilohtoc nochin tlen oncan. Niyan aquin nechixmati nehhuatl aquin niteconetzin, in tlahmo san Yehhuatzin in Notahtzin. Huan niyan aquin teixmati yec in Notahtzin in tlahmo nehhuatl, huan niquinixmatiltis yehhuan aquin nicnequis.

Xihualacan ica nehhuatl, namochten aquin nansiautoque ic onanquitlacamatiyayahque ica itlanahuatil san tlen tlacatl, tleca inon quen se tequitl chicahuac noso se tlamamali molui yetec. Huan nehhuatl namechsehuis huan ayacmo ijcon mechmohsihuisque.
Xicselican notlanehnehuilis tlen namechtlaliliya huan ximotemactican ica nehhuatl, tleca ahmo nimohsiuqui huan niyolyemanqui; huan nancahsisque nesehuilistli ipan namoyolo.
Tleca ahmo tequiyo notlanehnehuilis ic nanmomachtisque, huan ahmo yetec in notlanahuatil tlen ic namechtequiutiya.
